caseName: Cherrywood Apartments, Inc. v. United States
caseNameFull: CHERRYWOOD APARTMENTS, INC., OAKWOOD APARTMENTS, INC., APPLEWOOD APARTMENTS, INC., WOODSIDE BUILDING CORPORATION, WOODLAND PARK, INC. v. United States

opinions.text:
Just compensation for losses sustained by reason of Government housing competition; defendant’s demurrer sustained.

*929Plaintiffs’ petition for writ of certiorari denied by the Supreme Court January 2, 1952.
